about_the_game:
A malfunctioning instrument hurls a scientist 70 years into a desolate future. Beneath shattered neon lights, desperate girls yearn for hope. His arrival disrupts the world's course, and every click of choice rewrites the girls' fates. In this time-travel adventure, can he be the light that saves them from the darkness?
This demo covers the prologue and the first chapter of the main story.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes scenes of gunfights, homicide, bloodshed, corpses, and deaths in certain gameplay segments. Additionally, due to the worldbuilding, some settings may imply large-scale involvement of adult lower-class women in non-consensual sexual situations or sexual transactions (e.g., to illustrate the harsh living conditions of the underprivileged during debates, there may be descriptions or implications that most young women must engage in sexual transactions to maintain their finances and pay rent).
